findings.title: Reopened recruitment request/candidate editor shows old values after saving

checks.scenario: Read/update own recruitment request; preserve readonly ticket fields and reopen saved values
Edit own candidate; cancel preserves saved values and history tabs preserve draft

findings.observed: Own request quantity: PUT succeeds and subsequent GET returns 2, reopened UI stays at 1. Own candidate major: subsequent GET contains the saved TESTFE_* CNTT value, reopened UI stays empty.
findings.rootCause: RecruitmentEditor renders the form from stale cached detail while a new fetch is in flight. The keyed form uses useForm defaultValues and does not adopt the fresh row after initialization.
findings.recommendation: Initialize each newly opened form from fresh detail, or reset once when that opening receives its detail; preserve dirty inputs during later background refetches.

findings.title: Interview calendar grid cells lack required row parent semantics
findings.recommendation: Use the required grid → row → gridcell hierarchy for week/day calendar layouts and re-run axe on every calendar view.
findings.followUp: The initial axe scan in readonly run 08 passed, while run 02 captured the listed rule failures. View/data state affects reproduction; retain the failing-state evidence and check each calendar view separately.

findings.title: Due-date edit button cannot be clicked at its normal target

checks.scenario: Due date: reject non-extension, cancel draft and save/reopen a valid extension
Due date: reject non-extension, cancel draft and save/reopen a valid extension

findings.observed: Ordinary Playwright pointer clicks are repeatedly intercepted by the enclosing relative/min-w-0/space-y-1.5/pr-14 container. No force click or DOM event injection was used.
findings.recommendation: Inspect hit testing/stacking and the absolute button positioning inside TicketDueDate; verify mouse and touch interaction after correction.

findings.classification: Observed backend/network-dependent failure, not assigned to frontend business logic
findings.title: After deleting owned candidate, empty candidate search returns HTTP 500

checks.scenario: Delete only own disposable candidate and verify no results
Draft search, no results and reset recruitment filters

findings.observed: The delete UI completes, then /api/list_cv/ for the owned candidate returns 500. The table retains the old row; absence/deletion cannot be verified via the failing search. The same 500 also reproduces with an ordinary unmatched search; the test resets filters through UI in finally and subsequent readonly actions pass.
findings.recommendation: Review empty-result response handling on the service. Return a normal empty list; then re-run the UI deletion/no-results assertion. Do not infer deletion from toast alone.
